messages:
maria: FYI noticed org org-431 unexpectedly hit a per-key quota and got short-blocked. billing says theyre under quota though.
kevin: sample request id?
maria: r-9a8b7c. quick excerpt from our raw events:
```
request_id: r-9a8b7c
model: redwood-4x
prompt_tokens: 64
completion_tokens: 0
tool_calls: [{\"name\":\"web_search\",\"tokens\":22},{\"name\":\"kb_lookup\",\"tokens\":9}]
attempt: 2
dashboard_sum: 95
billing_after_dedupe: 75
```
jess: sounds like retries caused duplicate tool_token events in the realtime stream. billing window dedup removed dup but realtime dashboard + quota-enforcer counted both.
olivia: we recently changed attribution so tool plugins emit tokens on caller side; that increased duplicate keyspace during retries until the dedupe key was stabilized.
kevin: i pulled events via internal metering API and can confirm two identical web_search token events with same tool_id but different attempt index. billing post-process collapses by idempotency_key.
maria: consequence: per-key burst control fired (short 1m block) based on dashboard peak and interrupted a live customer flow.
cs-sandra: CS reached out — customer got a 429 during heavy onboarding. they'd like assurance this won't recur.
kevin: options discussed:
- make quota-enforcer consult billing-dedup view (accurate but adds latency to checks).
- add a lightweight dedupe cache service (per-org sliding window) that aggregator writes; quota-enforcer + dashboard use it for enforcement decisions.
- have dashboard detect likely-duplicates and exclude them from enforcement metrics (but still show raw in realtime UI).
jess: my vote: dedupe-cache service. keeps enforcement low-latency and consistent. we can make it eventual and TTL-based (e.g., 45s) to cover retry windows.
olivia: engineering notes: aggregator already emits dedup_key = sha(request_id + tool_call_id + attempt_nonce). we can have a small in-memory LRU per region with 60s TTL and an HTTP endpoint /v1/dedupe/exists?key=... for consumers.
maria: mitigations done: reduced sensitivity of auto-blocking for affected orgs and removed the transient 1m block. CS notified.
kevin: i'll spike dedupe sidecar this afternoon. plan: implement in metering-service as optional module behind feature flag, expose health + metrics. will canary to 5% of quota checks.
jess: i'll audit tokenizer/plugin changes to ensure token counts aren't inflated for structured tool outputs. will post findings.
olivia: i'll update the runbook with the dashboard vs canonical-billing divergence explanation and add a section for per-key burst false positives.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: metering-service v2.16.1 -> prod-canary at 2025-12-03T01:30Z (by kevin)
maria: action items: kevin implement dedupe-cache & PR, jess audit tokenizer/plugin counts, olivia update runbook + docs for dashboard semantics, cs-sandra confirm customer follow-up. we'll reconvene after the canary.
kevin: assigned to me. PR when ready. :thumbsup:
jess: starting audit now, will link results.
olivia: tagging @cs for follow-up.
maria: closing thread, follow-ups in ticket BILL-4721 and PRs. thanks all :raised_hands:
